name: repaso
description: Learn and don't forget, without an app: your agent turns what you learn into cards, quizzes you a few minutes a day, grades your answers and schedules each review with FSRS.

stays_local: the memory file with topics, plans, cards, every review and the settings (the agent queries it and sees the answers)
material the owner keeps in the folder and does not share in the conversation
agent_sees: the cards: questions, answers and where each one came from
the owner's answers, which are stored with each review
the topics, their goals and deadlines, the study plans and the progress
everything the owner types or shares in the conversation
cannot_guarantee: what the agent sees leaves the computer for the AI provider, under its terms
cards made by the agent can be wrong, above all those from its own knowledge; each card records where it came from so it can be corrected
the grade of an answer is the agent's judgment, not a measurement
reminders happen only when the owner opens a conversation; there are no push notifications
the memory file is not encrypted
